dashboard_item.raw_yaml:
title: Detect Suspicious Process Creation with rundll32.exe
id: 3b281054-f4b9-474e-801d-cf96c94a484f
status: experimental
description: Detects process creation events where svchost.exe spawns rundll32.exe
  with specific command line arguments, indicative of T1218.011.
references: https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1218/011/
author: SigmaGen
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.t1218.011
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: \rundll32.exe
    CommandLine|contains: acproxy.dll,PerformAutochkOperations
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative script execution
level: high
dashboard_item.wazuh_xml:
<group name="ml_generated,sysmon,">
  <rule id="100161" level="12">
    <if_group>sysmon_event1</if_group>
    <field name="win.eventdata.image" type="pcre2">(?i)\\+rundll32\.exe$</field>
    <field name="win.eventdata.commandLine" type="pcre2">(?i)acproxy\.dll,PerformAutochkOperations</field>
    <description>Detect Suspicious Process Creation with rundll32.exe [Alert: AI-20261012_133349.560-f64457544b1e]</description>
    <mitre>
      <id>T1218.011</id>
    </mitre>
  </rule>
</group>
